items.name: Foundry of Databricks
items.blurb: A handcrafted stop-motion puppet trophy representing the unified Delta triangle and Spark lightning of Databricks.

items.name: Foundations of Analysis and Science Seal
items.blurb: This wax seal honors the dual mastery of analytical reporting and predictive data science foundations.

items.name: The Compass of the Cascading Workspace
items.blurb: Awarded for mastering the intricate pathways of Databricks Workspace Navigation, finding the golden routes through catalog tables under the icy gaze of the data dragon.

items.name: The Great Clefs and Placement Felt Trophy
items.blurb: A whimsical hand-stitched felt creation celebrating note placement and key clefs, flanked by an angel, alligator, and friends who have gathered to learn the staff.

items.name: The Voice of Growth Trophy
items.blurb: Carved with an expressive Abyssinian cat and an acorn, this dark marble prize honors your ability to seed ideas and project them with natural, vocal confidence.

items.name: The Shuffling Mind
items.blurb: Representing the art of cognitive shuffling, this miniature bronze owl and Neanderthal navigate a tumbling cascade of scrambled thoughts to quiet the mind for rest.

items.name: The Tipped Scales of Elo & Value
items.blurb: An intricate armillary of spiraling rating stairs and weighted pricing scales, endlessly tested and mischievously tipped by climbing imps to represent AI pricing dynamics.

items.name: Navigation Astrolabe & Metastore Catalog
items.blurb: An intricate, ever-shifting navigational device used to catalog data pathways and manage workspace organization within the palace's Unity Catalog.
